title: Mây đêm
about: A replacement for k37 (Night Clouds, album 6), whose plain pad on a common D minor 9 / B-flat progression drew a 10-second Content ID match (the user: "bài 2 night cloud trong album bị dính content id nhạc khoảng 10s"); k37 is left as it was. Clouds drifting across a night sky, as before, but in F sharp minor on another progression, with an improvised glass tune and a music box in the middle, so it sounds and fingerprints nothing like the first. Sleep style (ngu-ngon). An original piece.
